bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 61
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path("deploy/state/startless-recover-missing-topic4291-20261122-retry1.json")
if not p.is_file():sys.exit(62)
x=json.loads(p.read_text())
if x.get("state")!="VERIFIED" or x.get("missing_original_id")!=4633 or not isinstance(x.get("message_id"),int):sys.exit(63)
mid=x["message_id"]
q="SELECT message_id,state,pinned FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE chat_id=-1002373696859 AND message_thread_id=4291"
r=subprocess.run(["docker","exec","deploy-postgres-1","psql","-X","-q","-v","ON_ERROR_STOP=1","-U","gace","-d","gaybbs","-Atc",q],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
if r.returncode or r.stdout.strip()!=f"{mid}|published|t":sys.exit(64)
a=subprocess.run(["python3","scripts/userbot_topic_audit_client.py","--chat-id","-1002373696859","--topic-id","4291"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=125)
if a.returncode:sys.exit(65)
d=[json.loads(z.split("=",1)[1]) for z in a.stdout.splitlines() if z.startswith("USERBOT_TOPIC_AUDIT=")]
if len(d)!=1 or len(d[0].get("rows",[]))!=1:sys.exit(66)
row=d[0]["rows"][0]
if row.get("post_button")!="PRESENT" or mid not in row.get("pin_message_ids",[])+row.get("history_message_ids",[]):sys.exit(67)
q="SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM startless_public_post_migrations WHERE state='applied')::text||'|'||(SELECT count(*) FROM startless_public_post_migrations WHERE state='uncertain')"
r=subprocess.run(["docker","exec","deploy-postgres-1","psql","-X","-q","-v","ON_ERROR_STOP=1","-U","gace","-d","gaybbs","-Atc",q],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
if r.returncode or r.stdout.strip()!="104|11":sys.exit(68)
print("TOPIC4291_NEW_CALLBACK_PIN=VERIFIED;OLD_MISSING_POST_UNTOUCHED=PASS;MIGRATION=104_APPLIED_11_UNCERTAIN")
PY
